g.text: D Stricter QC preserves regional uncertainty
Regional transfer and the article-defined cell QC check
RRRM-2: 18 different cerebral-region mice. RR10: nine bulk cerebral samples from already analyzed animals. RR8: article 5% versus GEO 50% mitochondrial gate.
A: circles = limma/voom with 95% moderated intervals; squares = edgeR QL. Filled = expanded 1,812-test q < 0.05. B: each point is one mouse; no new animal count from RR10.
C/D: 200–2,500 features and ≤5% mitochondrial RNA retain 62,351 cells across 47 libraries; each method keeps the full 3,624-target contrast family. Points are estimates, not cells.
The source threshold discrepancy is retained explicitly. Whole-mouse inference, processing-day and preservation confounds, and unconfirmed hippocampal PYCARD remain.
